role.label: Class of Warrant or Right [Domain]
role.documentation: Name of the class or type of warrant or right outstanding. Warrants and rights represent derivative securities that give the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specific price within a certain time frame. Warrants are often included in a new debt issue to entice investors by a higher return potential. The main difference between warrants and call options is that warrants are issued and guaranteed by the company, whereas options are exchange instruments and are not issued by the company. Also, the lifetime of a warrant is often measured in years, while the lifetime of a typical option is measured in months.

That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

role.label: Risk-free interest rate
role.documentation: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

role.label: us-gaap_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNonOptionEquityInstrumentsOutstandingNumber
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding, Number (in shares)
role.documentation: Number of equity instruments other than options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested instruments.

role.label: ng_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfCommonSharesPerAward
role.terseLabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Common Shares Per Award
role.documentation: Represents the number of common shares to be granted for each share-based payment award.

role.label: ng_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfCommonSharesPerAwardAdjustedMultiplier
role.terseLabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Common Shares Per Award, Adjusted, Multiplier
role.documentation: Represents the percentage multiplier that may be used in order to determine the adjusted number of common shares to be granted per share-based payment award, based on the achievement of certain performance criteria.

role.label: us-gaap_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant
role.documentation: The difference between the maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) authorized for issuance under the plan (including the effects of amendments and adjustments), and the sum of: 1) the number of shares (or other type of equity) already issued upon exercise of options or other equity-based awards under the plan; and 2) shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance on granting of outstanding awards, net of cancellations and forfeitures, if applicable.

role.label: Vested and exercisable as of November 30, 2024 (in shares)
role.documentation: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

role.label: Vested and exercisable as of November 30, 2024 (in dollars per share)
role.documentation: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

role.label: Intrinsic value of options exercised
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

role.label: us-gaap_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodGross
role.documentation: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

role.label: Weighted-average grant-date fair value (in dollars per share)
role.documentation: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

role.label: Vested and exercisable, aggregate intrinsic value
role.documentation: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

role.label: Vested and exercisable (in shares)
role.documentation: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

role.label: Vested and exercisable, weighted average exercise price outstanding (in dollars per share)
role.periodStartLabel: Weighted average exercise price outstanding, balance (in dollars per share)
role.documentation: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

role.label: ng_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardPortionVestingPerYear
role.terseLabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Portion Vesting Per Year
role.documentation: Represents the portion of share-based payment awards vesting per year.

role.label: us-gaap_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardSharesIssuedInPeriod
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Shares Issued in Period
role.documentation: Number of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Award Type [Domain]
role.documentation: Award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.verboseLabel: Exercised, weighted average exercise price (in dollars per share)
role.label: us-gaap_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsExercisesInPeriodWeightedAverageExercisePrice
role.documentation: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

role.verboseLabel: Granted, weighted average exercise price (in dollars per share)
role.label: us-gaap_ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageExercisePrice
role.documentation: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, methodology and assumption used in measuring cost.

role.label: Share Capital [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for share capital.

role.label: PSU Awards, Aggregate intrinsic value
role.documentation: Intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

role.label: Expired (in shares)
role.documentation: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were expired during the reporting period.

role.label: Expired (in dollars per share)
role.documentation: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were expired.

role.label: us-gaap_SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Expiration Period (Year)
role.documentation: Period from grant date that an equity-based award expires, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Expected term of options (years) (Year)
role.documentation: Expected term of award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Vested and exercisable as of November 30, 2024
role.documentation: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

role.label: Vested and exercisable as of November 30, 2024 (Year)
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: us-gaap_SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardOptionsNonvestedNumberOfShares
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares
role.documentation: Number of non-vested options outstanding.

role.label: Vested and exercisable, weighted-average remaining contractual term (Year)
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: us-gaap_SharesIssuedPricePerShare
role.documentation: Per share or per unit amount of equity securities issued.

role.label: us-gaap_SharesOutstanding
role.documentation: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

role.label: Short-term lease cost
role.documentation: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

role.label: Significant Accounting Policies [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for all significant accounting policies of the reporting entity.

role.label: Equity Components [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by component of equity.

role.label: Statement [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Statement [Table]
role.documentation: Presentation of information about comprehensive income, income, other comprehensive income, financial position, cash flows, and shareholders' equity.

role.label: Equity offerings, net (Note 11) (in shares)
role.terseLabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
role.documentation: Number of new stock issued during the period.

role.label: Share units settled in shares (in shares)
role.documentation: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

role.label: Stock options exercised (in shares)
role.documentation: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

role.label: Equity offerings, net (Note 11)
role.documentation: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

role.label: Share units settled in shares
role.documentation: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

role.verboseLabel: Total fair value of common shares issued
role.label: us-gaap_StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensationGross
role.documentation: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

role.label: Stock options exercised
role.documentation: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

role.label: us-gaap_StockholdersEquity
role.documentation: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

role.label: Equity [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for equity.

role.label: Sale of Stock [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of sale of the entity's stock.

role.label: Summary of Operating Loss Carryforwards [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of pertinent information, such as tax authority, amounts, and expiration dates, of net operating loss carryforwards, including an assessment of the likelihood of utilization.

role.label: us-gaap_TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount
role.documentation: The amount of the tax credit carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

role.label: Tax Credit Carryforward [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by specific tax credit related to an unused tax credit.

role.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The name of the tax credit carryforward.

role.label: Tax Period [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by period subject to enacted tax law.

role.label: Tax Period [Domain]
role.documentation: Identified tax period.

role.label: us-gaap_TaxesPayableCurrent
role.documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

role.label: Term Deposits, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for term deposits.

role.label: Trading Symbol
role.documentation: Trading symbol of an instrument as listed on an exchange.

role.label: ng_UnconsolidatedVenturesNumberOfDirectors
role.documentation: Represents the total number of directors on the board of an unconsolidated venture, including those selected by the reporting entity and/or the venture partner.

role.label: ng_UnconsolidatedVenturesNumberOfDirectorsSelectedByTheReportingEntity
role.terseLabel: Unconsolidated Ventures, Number of Directors, Selected By the Reporting Entity
role.documentation: Represents the number of directors on the board of unconsolidated ventures, which directors are selected by the reporting entity.

role.label: ng_UnconsolidatedVenturesNumberOfDirectorsSelectedByVenturePartners
role.terseLabel: Unconsolidated Ventures, Number of Directors Selected By Venture Partners
role.documentation: Represents the number of directors on the board of unconsolidated ventures, which directors are selected by the reporting entity's venture partners.

role.label: us-gaap_UnrecognizedTaxBenefits
role.documentation: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

role.label: Variable lease cost
role.documentation: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

role.label: Warrant expense (Note 11)
role.documentation: Amount of expense related to warrants.

role.label: us-gaap_WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding
role.documentation: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

role.label: ng_WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingFairValuePerShare
role.terseLabel: Warrants and Rights Outstanding, Fair Value Per Share
role.documentation: Value of outstanding derivative securities, per share, that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

role.label: us-gaap_WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingMeasurementInput
role.terseLabel: Warrants and Rights Outstanding, Measurement Input
role.documentation: Value of input used to measure outstanding warrant and right embodying unconditional obligation requiring redemption by transferring asset at specified or determinable date or upon event certain to occur.

role.label: Basic and diluted (thousands) (in shares)
role.documentation: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

role.label: ng_WorkingCapitalAdjustment
role.documentation: Represents the amount of working capital adjustment paid during the period.
